listings.name: Sheriff Pretoria South West
listings.current_description: Sheriff Pretoria South West is a Sheriff of the Court office on Iron Terrace in West Park, responsible for serving and executing court documents such as summonses, notices, warrants and court orders across its Pretoria South West jurisdiction.

listings.name: Sherlock Data Recovery Services
listings.current_description: Sherlock Data Recovery Services is a data recovery specialist in Waterkloof Glen handling RAID, server, NAS and SAN recovery as well as hard-drive recovery from fire, water and physical damage, serving clients across Pretoria, Centurion, Midrand and Johannesburg.

listings.name: SITA SOC Ltd
listings.current_description: SITA SOC Ltd is South Africa's state-owned information technology agency, established in 1999 to consolidate government IT resources and provide network management, hosting, application development, security and e-government services to state departments, with an office in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria.

listings.name: Sol-Tech (Monumentpark-kampus)
listings.current_description: Sol-Tech (Monumentpark-kampus) is a private vocational training college in Monument Park, Pretoria, offering Afrikaans-medium, skills-based training in technical trades such as diesel mechanics, electrical work, mechatronics and welding, as well as IT, early childhood development and hairdressing qualifications.

listings.name: Solar Hub SA - BESS
listings.current_description: Solar Hub SA - BESS is a solar energy and battery storage company based in Kameeldrift, Pretoria, providing off-grid and on-grid solar installations, battery energy storage systems, power purchase agreements, and full regulatory and maintenance support for businesses.

listings.name: Stage Effects Group
listings.current_description: Stage Effects Group is a technical event production and rental company in Derdepoort providing staging, lighting, LED screens and rigging for concerts, festivals, theatre productions, corporate events and broadcast and film work, with over 18 years of experience.

listings.name: STANRIO PIPE & STEEL PTY LTD
listings.current_description: STANRIO PIPE & STEEL is a steel merchant established in 1979 in Silverton, Pretoria, supplying tubing, angle iron, sheeting, stainless steel and aluminium sections, plus CNC plasma cutting, welding and fabrication services to contractors, mines and DIY customers.

listings.name: Starbright Solutions
listings.current_description: Starbright Solutions is a full-service digital marketing agency in Blue Valley Golf Estate offering web design and development, SEO and Google Ads management, Meta Ads and social media content, plus email marketing, copywriting and graphic and UX design.

listings.name: Stephnie's
listings.current_description: Stephnie's is a fine-dining restaurant at Lynnwood Bridge known as a culinary theatre, serving a menu spanning steak, burgers, French-inspired dishes and vegetarian and vegan options across breakfast, lunch and dinner, with a licensed bar and live entertainment.

listings.name: Synercore Manufacturing
listings.current_description: Synercore Manufacturing is a food-ingredient and formulation company based in Hermanstad, Pretoria, developing customised blends, cultures, emulsifiers and grain-flour products for dairy, bakery, beverage, meat and plant-based food manufacturers since 2016, alongside contract blending, spray-drying and milling services.

listings.name: The Bushbaby Inn
listings.current_description: The Bushbaby Inn is a 10-room guest house in Lydiana with air-conditioned rooms, private bathrooms and free WiFi, set in an indigenous garden with an outdoor pool, braai area and secure parking, close to the National Botanical Gardens.

listings.name: The Decisionsmiths
listings.current_description: The Decisionsmiths is a decision-intelligence consulting firm combining data analytics and behavioural science to help organisations across sectors such as mining, engineering, insurance and retail improve strategic decision-making, offering diagnostic assessments, data intelligence platforms and AI-assisted decision tools.

listings.name: The Echelon Group (PTY) LTD
listings.current_description: The Echelon Group is an advisory and consultancy firm founded in 2012, providing strategic consulting, business development and investment services including project planning, feasibility studies, market intelligence and institutional reviews for corporates, governments and development organisations across Africa.

listings.name: The Facilitators (One Stop Between You and the NHBRC)
listings.current_description: The Facilitators is a service provider that facilitates NHBRC registrations, renewals and enrolments between home builders, developers and the NHBRC, also offering insurance solutions such as professional indemnity, contractors' all-risk and performance guarantees, based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion.

listings.name: The Queen Pet Shop - Nina Park
listings.current_description: The Queen Pet Shop - Nina Park stocks food, treats and supplies for dogs, cats, small animals, birds, fish and reptiles, carries premium brands such as Hill's Science Plan and Royal Canin, and offers an in-store grooming parlour.

listings.name: the South African Creative Industries Incubator
listings.current_description: The South African Creative Industries Incubator is a turnkey creative hub in Eersterust, Pretoria, offering technical skills training, business incubation, production facilities and networking support for creative-industry entrepreneurs and SMMEs, alongside sister sites in Johannesburg and Cape Town.

listings.name: The Specialists Franchise Group Head Office (Pest Control, Cleaning & Hygiene)
listings.current_description: The Specialists Franchise Group Head Office coordinates a Southern African network of more than 70 owner-managed branches providing pest control, cleaning and washroom hygiene services to residential, commercial and industrial clients, drawing on nearly five decades of experience.

listings.name: Thinkroom Consulting
listings.current_description: Thinkroom Consulting is an SME development consulting firm working with African entrepreneurs across more than 30 countries, offering an online training platform, a structured enterprise-acceleration programme and go-to-market strategy services for high-growth businesses, from its Midstream Estate office.

listings.name: Tubecon Africa
listings.current_description: Tubecon Africa, established in 1977, manufactures steel tubes and profiles including structural, scaffold, conveyor and borehole casing tubes, plus laser cutting, flaring and swaging services, with manufacturing in Pretoria and a branch in Cape Town serving southern Africa.

listings.name: Turner Morris Pretoria
listings.current_description: Turner Morris is a South African industrial equipment supplier and manufacturer established in 1936, distributing agricultural and construction equipment, generators and power systems, solar and home-energy products, and power and hand tools; this location trades from Silverton, Pretoria.

listings.name: Typewrite Office Equipment
listings.current_description: Typewrite Office Equipment is a stationery and office-equipment supplier in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, trading since 1980 and selling printer, ink and toner cartridges, Trodat self-inking stamps and office equipment from brands including Brother, Canon, Epson, HP and Samsung.

listings.name: Unahina Business Solutions
listings.current_description: Unahina Business Solutions is a contract-based funding provider in Menlo Park offering purchase order funding, tender funding and invoice discounting to help South African businesses fulfil confirmed orders and government or corporate contracts without disrupting their working capital.

listings.name: UniNetwork
listings.current_description: UniNetwork is a construction-industry connector based in Montana Park that links consumers with building resources across Gauteng, operates digital billboard advertising at high-traffic Pretoria intersections, and provides construction, property-maintenance and insurance-repair work through its subsidiary Astute Business Solutions.

listings.name: Venter and Geldenhuys Inc.
listings.current_description: Venter and Geldenhuys Inc. is an Erasmusrand law firm specialising in commercial law and business litigation, also practising family law, criminal law, business rescue, personal injury, labour law and insolvency law across the High Court and Magistrates' Court.

listings.name: VENTURE OTTO SA (PTY) LTD
listings.current_description: Venture Otto SA is a Boardwalk Meander-based engineering and surveying firm forming part of the Venture Global group, a multinational industrial manufacturer active in automotive systems, prefabricated construction and tool design with facilities in South Africa and abroad.

listings.name: Vetceuticals Veterinary Wholesaler
listings.current_description: Vetceuticals Veterinary Wholesaler distributes veterinary pharmaceuticals and animal-health products from Roodeplaat for small-scale livestock farmers, stocking small animal, equine, cattle, sheep, pig and poultry lines from brands including Zoetis, Virbac, MSD Animal Health, Bayer, Boehringer Ingelheim and Elanco.

listings.name: Vision Group Consulting
listings.current_description: Vision Group Consulting is an engineering firm at Highveld Techno Park specialising in process and industrial automation, control and instrumentation, SCADA systems, electrical engineering and turnkey industrial solutions for mining, oil and gas, pharmaceutical and water treatment industries.

listings.name: Vos Consulting - Business and Management Consultant Pretoria
listings.current_description: Vos Consulting is a business and management consultancy based in Riviera, Pretoria, helping CEOs of small and medium enterprises grow revenue and strengthen organisational effectiveness through strategic guidance and practical operational improvements, serving clients in Pretoria and Johannesburg.

listings.name: Vulindlela Financial Services
listings.current_description: Vulindlela Financial Services is an authorised financial services provider (FSP 49685) based in Copperleaf Golf and Country Estate, Centurion, offering short-term personal and commercial insurance as well as long-term insurance products through partnerships with major South African insurers.

listings.name: W. G. HAESE & PARTNERS
listings.current_description: W. G. Haese & Partners is a multidisciplinary consulting practice in Lynnwood Glen established in 1968, offering consulting engineering in civil, electrical, mechanical and structural disciplines alongside architecture, town planning and valuation services under one project planning umbrella.

listings.name: Water Research Commission
listings.current_description: The Water Research Commission is South Africa's national water knowledge and research body, established in 1971 to fund and coordinate research into water resources management, water and wastewater use, and agricultural water use, from its Lynnwood Bridge office.

listings.name: Woodpecker Playgrounds - Jungle Gyms
listings.current_description: Woodpecker Playgrounds has manufactured and installed custom wooden jungle gyms and outdoor play equipment across Gauteng for over 23 years, offering standard SABS-treated models as well as fully custom-designed units with swings, slides, sand pits and climbing structures.

listings.name: Wrapsa (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Wrapsa is a pharmaceutical contract manufacturer established in 1983, one of the first third-party pharmaceutical manufacturing and packing operators in South Africa, offering manufacturing, packaging and laboratory services including consignment raw-material handling, medicine registration assistance and validation support.

listings.name: Xneelo
listings.current_description: Xneelo, based in Samrand Business Park, Kosmosdal, is a South African web hosting provider founded in 1999 (formerly Hetzner SA), offering domain registration, shared and dedicated hosting, managed and cloud servers, and colocation services with 24/7 support.

listings.name: XS Sure
listings.current_description: XS Sure is an authorised financial services provider (FSP 21101) offering short-term insurance add-on products such as excess and deductible waivers, tyre, windscreen and rim cover, geyser and power-surge protection, and credit-shortfall cover, designed to supplement existing policies.

listings.name: Xyrax
listings.current_description: Xyrax is an internet service provider based in Thatchfield Estate, Centurion, established in 2018, offering fibre and fixed wireless connectivity plus business services such as VoIP, managed firewalls, VPN and surveillance systems with 24/7 remote technical support.

listings.name: Yanga Environmental Services
listings.current_description: Yanga Environmental Services, established in 2018 and 100% Black-owned, offers waste management, environmental management, civil works, geohydrology and occupational health and safety services from its Pretoria office, including approved asbestos contracting and a 24-hour emergency spill response line.

listings.name: Yellow Lemon Media
listings.current_description: Yellow Lemon Media, based in Highveld, Pretoria, is a visual communications agency with more than 10 years of experience offering video production, live streaming, photography, graphic design, brand development and social media management, including real estate photography packages.

listings.name: Adv. Modidima Mannya
listings.current_description: Adv. Modidima Mannya is a Pretoria-based advocate of the High Court and legal commentator, formerly a legal adviser to a government minister and premier and head of the Unisa legal services department, now running a legal practice from Murrayfield.

listings.name: Advance Cash n Carry
listings.current_description: Advance Cash n Carry is the largest bulk grocery store in Pretoria, a landmark wholesale outlet in Hermanstad founded in 2002 with a 17,000 square metre trading area selling bulk groceries, FMCG, household products and personal care items.

listings.name: African Consulting Surveyors
listings.current_description: African Consulting Surveyors (ACS) is a precision surveying and geospatial solutions firm formed in 2000, offering airborne and mobile LiDAR mapping, 3D scanning and hydrographic surveys to the mining, construction and infrastructure sectors across Africa from its Doornpoort office.

listings.name: Afrison LED
listings.current_description: Afrison LED is a Lyttelton Manor-based manufacturer of high-end industrial LED lighting and energy-efficient lighting solutions, also offering energy audits, retrofit installations, audio-visual systems and IoT solutions; the company was acquired by White Pearl Technology Group in August 2025.

listings.name: Afrox Silvertondale
listings.current_description: Afrox Silvertondale is a branch of Afrox, South Africa's largest supplier of industrial gases and welding products and a member of the Linde Group, providing gases for welding, purging, refrigeration and fuel along with LPG cylinders and gas equipment.

listings.name: Akarnia Hardware + Build
listings.current_description: Akarnia Hardware + Build, established in 2016, is a DIY and hardware retailer in Kloofsig, Centurion, stocking tools, building materials, paint, plumbing and garden supplies, with its own delivery fleet serving Gauteng and a hands-on, one-on-one approach to customer service.

listings.name: Alternative Finance Group (AFG)
listings.current_description: Alternative Finance Group (AFG) is a non-bank finance provider in Centurion offering funding to small and medium enterprises, including asset-backed short-term loans, purchase order funding, bridging finance and invoice discounting through its group companies CorpFin, ProfitHub, QuickBridge and DiscountDesk.

listings.name: AMC Consultants - Centurion
listings.current_description: AMC Consultants is a global mining consultancy providing geological, geotechnical and mining engineering services to the resources sector, operating from a Centurion office; the firm was founded in 1983 and has advised more than 1,800 mining clients worldwide.

listings.name: ARC-Onderstepoort Veterinary Institute
listings.current_description: ARC-Onderstepoort Veterinary Institute is a veterinary research campus of the Agricultural Research Council, recognised internationally since 1908 for its work on livestock and wildlife disease diagnostics, vaccine development (including for foot-and-mouth disease and tick-borne diseases), and animal health surveillance.

listings.name: Ariston South Africa
listings.current_description: Ariston South Africa is a water heater manufacturer based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion (formerly Heat Tech Geysers, acquired by Ariston Thermo in 2014), producing electric, gas and solar water heaters and heat pumps for residential and small commercial use.

listings.name: Auditor-General South Africa
listings.current_description: The Auditor-General South Africa (AGSA) head office is based at Lynnwood Bridge, Pretoria, conducting regularity audits of national and provincial government departments, public entities and municipalities, along with performance audits, special audits and investigations, from 13 office locations nationwide.

listings.name: Auto Pedigree
listings.current_description: Auto Pedigree Centurion is a used-car dealership in Hennopspark, part of a South African brand with over 35 years in the industry, buying, selling and trading bakkies, 4x4s, SUVs and sports cars including Kia, Mercedes-Benz, Toyota and Volkswagen models.
